_comment: Single source of truth for the cards on index.html. There is no build step: docs/apps.js fetches this file and renders the cards, section headings and jump links at load time, so editing this file is the whole change. Section order here is the order on the page and in the hero navigation. Icons are inline SVG names from docs/apps.js, not files. Visitors without JavaScript see the hand-maintained fallback list in the <noscript> block of docs/index.html, which must be updated by hand when a card changes.

sections.label: AI
sections.intro: Tools and resources for using generative AI in your teaching, and for understanding what the research says about it.

cards.title: AI-Era Assignment Design Coach
cards.description: Design and redesign assignments for an AI-capable world. Use the Gemini Notebook or Playlab version; instructions and examples are in a shared folder, or try a non-AI worksheet with fewer features. The notebook balances authenticity, observability and feasibility rather than trying to make assignments AI-proof, and it walks through what an assignment asks students to learn, what successful work looks like, and where generative AI belongs.

thumb.aria: Open the AI-Era Assignment Design Coach Gemini Notebook

cards.title: AI Petting Zoo
cards.description: A self-paced, guided tour of AI tools and the teaching tasks they can help with, built around saving instructors time and enhancing student learning and engagement. It covers Gemini and features such as deep research, images, video and canvas, NotebookLM and features such as notebooks, podcasts and infographics, and other tools, pairing each with example tasks to try in your own course.

thumb.aria: Start the AI Petting Zoo tour

cards.title: AI in Education Knowledge Base
cards.description: A research knowledge base on AI in education: concept pages, study summaries, FAQ pages and resource reviews. Ask it questions through the AI in Education Advisor Gem, or read it as a NotebookLM notebook. Both draw on the same material, and offline EPUB and PDF editions are available for reading or printing.

thumb.aria: Browse the AI in Education Knowledge Base

cards.title: Online Module Designer
cards.description: A custom Gemini Gem for designing online learning modules, from outcomes and activities to assessment.

thumb.aria: Open the Online Module Designer Gem

cards.title: AI Literacy Resources
cards.description: A Canvas course collecting ready-to-use AI literacy materials for students, in two modules. One gathers AI literacy frameworks, research and FAQs, and resources for teaching AI literacy across the curriculum. The other is a set of sample SLS (Student Life Skills) activities on using AI for college and career success: resources for using AI ethically to support your learning, a knowledge check quiz on ethical AI use, an academic habits AI coaching activity to try, a discussion on building your own AI learning tool, a dynamic assessment quiz, and a Career Dreamer assignment using Google's AI career exploration tool.

thumb.aria: Open the AI Literacy Resources course

cards.title: Academic Habits Coach
cards.description: An AI chat activity that guides students through scenarios about academic habits — planning, studying, and what to do when work gets difficult — and asks them to think through what each choice could lead to. Students can optionally enter a name, their courses, and their major or career interest so the instructor can give credit for completing it. For a version with no live AI, Make Learning Yours is a private, offline reflection activity: no login and no automatic submission, progress saved only in the student’s own browser, ending in a study plan and a printable certificate.

thumb.aria: Start the Academic Habits Coach activity

cards.title: AI Teaching Coach
cards.description: An AI chat that helps instructors identify and mitigate the teaching issues affecting student success, pairing each one with evidence-based strategies. It asks what you teach and whether the course is online, face-to-face or both, then works through what may be getting in the way and what to try. The instructions and resources are in a shared folder, and From a teaching issue to a practical next step is a non-AI worksheet version: about 10–15 minutes, saved only in your own browser, ending in a focused change, the language to use with students, and a way to check the result.

thumb.aria: Start the AI Teaching Coach activity

sections.label: Accessibility
sections.intro: Resources for designing courses and materials that work for every student.

cards.title: Canvas Accessibility Checklist
cards.description: A practical Canvas accessibility checklist. Choose what you are working with, such as a page, a document or a video, and it walks through what to check and how to fix it in Canvas, with a reminder to verify the result with a person rather than a tool alone. It links to a core resource library and covers the accessibility issues AI can and cannot help with.

cards.title: Digital Accessibility for Teaching and Learning
cards.description: A book on accessible course design, documents and media in higher education, written by Hillsborough College authors and published under a non-commercial Creative Commons license. It gives practical guidance for making the materials students read, watch and listen to work with assistive technology.

cards.title: Alt Text Generator
cards.description: A custom Gemini Gem for writing alt text, so students who cannot see an image still get the information it carries.

thumb.aria: Open the Alt Text Generator Gem

sections.label: Teaching
sections.intro: Canvas courses and checklists for teaching in Canvas, from getting started to teaching online.

cards.title: Faculty Teaching & Instructional Technology Resources
cards.description: A Canvas course that works as a teaching handbook for HCC faculty. Its modules cover Hillsborough College resources (instructor quick links, handouts, policies and templates, college data), what students need (student populations, student learning, motivation and engagement, mental health and well-being), teaching topics (new faculty, online teaching, syllabus, first day of class, first exam or assignment tips), technologies (Canvas and Canvas Studio, accessibility, open educational resources, artificial intelligence, effective videos), and discipline-specific resources for STEM, humanities, social sciences and professional disciplines. Further modules cover alternative assessment options and the Respondus LockDown Browser and Honorlock proctoring tools.

thumb.aria: Open the Faculty Teaching & Instructional Technology Resources course

cards.title: Canvas Starter Kit
cards.description: An optional Canvas course you can copy into your own to save time building it. It comes with a welcome homepage you can rewrite, banner images and buttons you can swap from the files area, and a walkthrough video on importing and customizing it. Highlighted notes in the course are instructions to delete or edit as you go. Import a copy from Canvas Commons by searching for HCC Canvas Starter Kit.

thumb.aria: Open the Canvas Starter Kit course

cards.title: Evidence-based Teaching in Canvas
cards.description: A Canvas course of evidence-based teaching strategies, each with a short explanation and ready-made Canvas items you can adapt: transparent assignment templates, values affirmation and goal setting surveys, social belonging and student testimonial activities, anxiety reappraisal, growth mindset, mindfulness, minute papers, nudges, exam wrappers, midterm student feedback, discussion protocols, and student success skills. Import a copy from Canvas Commons or the included .imscc file.

thumb.aria: See the Evidence-based Teaching in Canvas course

cards.title: Online Teaching in Canvas Checklist
cards.description: A checklist for building an online course in Canvas, grouped into accessibility and usability (link validator, Ally report, alt text, captions, document remediation), content, activities and organization (navigation, syllabus, homepage, orientation module, assignment groups), student and faculty interaction (first-week activities, feedback, discussion), learning objectives and alignment, and a course mapping template. It also covers using AI to save time and fix accessibility issues.

thumb.aria: Open the Online Teaching in Canvas Checklist
